title: PakMaweshi — Pakistan's digital livestock ecosystem.
desc: A Trovec Technologies project connecting farmers, traders and buyers through AI-assisted trading, trust, and transparency — livestock marketplace, live auctions, verified traders, veterinary services, insurance, financing, logistics, and meat export/abattoir services, alongside a marketplace store for feed, seed, and equipment. Currently a website prototype; not yet a live transacting marketplace, and no financial or user projections are published here.
